idx_activity_events_source_position.name: idx_activity_events_source_position
idx_activity_events_source_position.where: "activity_events"."source_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_events"."source_index" IS NOT NULL

check_activity_event_actor.name: check_activity_event_actor
check_activity_event_actor.value:
(
        ("activity_events"."actor_kind" = 'user' AND "activity_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_events"."actor_kind" IN ('historical', 'system') AND "activity_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)
      )

check_activity_event_source.name: check_activity_event_source
check_activity_event_source.value:
(
        ("activity_events"."source" = 'native' AND "activity_events"."actor_kind" IN ('user', 'system')
          AND "activity_events"."source_record_id" IS NULL AND "activity_events"."source_event_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_events"."source_index" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_events"."source" = 'linear' AND "activity_events"."source_record_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_events"."source_index" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_events"."actor_kind" = 'historical'
          AND "activity_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)
      )

check_comment_source_shape.name: check_comment_source_shape
check_comment_source_shape.value:
(
        ("comments"."source" = 'native' AND "comments"."author_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "comments"."source_record_id" IS NULL AND "comments"."source_comment_id" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."source_parent_comment_id" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_author_name" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_created_at" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_updated_at" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_quoted_text" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("comments"."source" = 'linear' AND "comments"."author_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "comments"."source_record_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "comments"."source_comment_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_author_name" IS NOT NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_created_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "comments"."historical_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )
